name: System Shock 2

steam.store_details: The classic 1999 build was delisted in October 2025, and only the 25th Anniversary Remaster is sold now.
steam.patches: The System Shock 2 Community Patch (SCP) fixes bugs and polishes the game, and is worth installing alongside EAX.

gog.store_details: The classic 1999 build was delisted in October 2025, and only the 25th Anniversary Remaster is sold now.

audio_settings.title: Enable underwater reverb
audio_settings.reason: Some System Shock 2 maps don't mark their underwater areas, so they play the wrong reverb there.

optional_settings.title: Enable full-precision mouse look
optional_settings.reason: System Shock 2 reads mouse look through standard Windows input by default, which doesn't give high-resolution mice their full precision.

notes: It comes with NewDark pre-installed, which has its own 'Hardware Acceleration' option in the in-game Audio menu — worth trying if EAX doesn't sound right.
